name: Bell Run

location.description: Market Bell to Oldroad Gate and back

steps.name: Receive Message Satchel
steps.description: Receive a message satchel from the Market Bell keeper

steps.name: Run the Route
steps.description: Carry the message to one of three district signposts

steps.name: Ring the Bell
steps.description: Ring the small bell at the destination signpost

loopDescription: The player carries a message from the Market Bell to a district signpost, rings a bell, and returns before the message expires.
failureState: If the player does not return before the message expires, the satchel disappears and the run fails. No penalty beyond lost time.

name: Soot Sweep

steps.name: Sweep Soot Pile
steps.description: Sweep a soot pile from the Sootcellar floor

steps.name: Clear Grave Mites
steps.description: Fight or flee Grave Mites that emerge from the soot

loopDescription: The player sweeps soot piles from the Sootcellar floor, clearing paths and reducing Grave Mite spawn chances.
failureState: If overwhelmed by Grave Mites, the player is forced to retreat. No death penalty, but the sweep is incomplete.
